QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Plight of the Pale Specter
QuestInfo.0: The Pale Specter looks seems to want your attention. See what it has to say.
QuestInfo.1: The Pale Specter asks you to retrieve #t4034857# because it's concerned about its 'skin.' You think that #p9112008# might be able to help.
QuestInfo.2: You traded #p9112008# #t4034859# for #p4034857#. But when the Pale Specter drank the #p4034857#, it went mad and attacked. Something suspicious is definitely going on here.
